{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "plas_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized plasma glucose concentration relative to training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes glucose contribution in Euclidean distance computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 119.20434782608696) / 31.280456160646818"
    },
    {
      "name": "mass_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized BMI relative to training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-4.5, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes BMI scale so it weighs comparably to other features in distance metrics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.211304347826086) / 7.5253053119330096"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age relative to training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Brings age onto unit-variance scale for KNN distance fairness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 32.93913043478261) / 11.313160444537871"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedi_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and standardized diabetes pedigree function for skew-corrected scaling.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skew in pedigree and standardizes magnitude for distance computations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(pedi) - 0.36) / 0.20"
    },
    {
      "name": "insu_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and standardized insulin value to compress its large range.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents insulin's wide range from dominating Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(insu) - 3.5) / 2.2"
    },
    {
      "name": "missing_biomarker_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of biomarker fields recorded as zero (plas, pres, skin, insu, mass), which typically indicate missing measurements.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "data_quality_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a cluster indicator separating rows with poor measurement quality from complete rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas <= 0, 1, 0) + np.where(pres <= 0, 1, 0) + np.where(skin <= 0, 1, 0) + np.where(insu <= 0, 1, 0) + np.where(mass <= 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_global_centroid",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance of standardized row vector to training-set global centroid (origin in z-space).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an unsupervised prototype distance helping KNN identify outliers vs dense regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas - 119.20434782608696) / 31.280456160646818) ** 2 + ((mass - 31.211304347826086) / 7.5253053119330096) ** 2 + ((age - 32.93913043478261) / 11.313160444537871) ** 2 + ((pres - 68.06521739130434) / 18.528241867264995) ** 2 + ((preg - 3.8130434782608695) / 3.197118858927462) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_load_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite scaled sum of glucose, BMI, and insulin z-scores capturing metabolic stress dimension.",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "domain_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aligns the dominant metabolic axis as a single coordinate to improve neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 119.20434782608696) / 31.280456160646818 + (mass - 31.211304347826086) / 7.5253053119330096 + (np.log1p(insu) - 3.5) / 2.2"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_preg_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Pregnancies normalized by age above adulthood, indicating reproductive history intensity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures a demographic interaction that separates clusters of young low-parity vs older multiparous rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(preg / np.maximum(age - 18.0, 1.0), 0.0, 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_obesity_band",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal band for BMI: 0 underweight/missing, 1 normal, 2 overweight, 3 obese, 4 severely obese.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates discrete BMI clusters strengthening neighborhood cohesion in distance space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mass <= 0, 0, np.where(mass < 25, 1, np.where(mass < 30, 2, np.where(mass < 35, 3, 4))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_risk_band",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal glucose bands using clinical thresholds: 0 missing, 1 normal (<100), 2 prediabetic (<126), 3 diabetic-range, 4 very high (>=160).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides categorical structure for glucose that aids KNN cluster separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas <= 0, 0, np.where(plas < 100, 1, np.where(plas < 126, 2, np.where(plas < 160, 3, 4))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "biomarker_plausibility",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall physiological plausibility of the row: scored higher when biomarkers are present, internally consistent (e.g., skin thickness consistent with BMI, insulin consistent with glucose), and within typical adult ranges; lower when values are missing or contradictory.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Down-weights noisy or implausible rows so KNN neighborhoods are formed among reliably measured points.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
